name: Raven Code
summary: A small editor for Rust projects made only of RavenRS components, on the DockArea: it opens a project from disk, edits and saves its files, builds and runs it with cargo and answers through rust-analyzer. The seed of the RavenRS IDE.
when_to_use: To open and edit a Rust project, build it and run it, in an editor made with RavenRS.
To try the DockArea, the code editor and the language server together, in a real app.

commands.does: Opens the project in the folder, or the sample project with no folder. Closing the window keeps it beside the clock.
Builds the editor on the sample project with no window; exit code 0 when it draws.

limits: rust-analyzer has to be installed for the language features.
It is the seed of the IDE (#495): debugging and refactoring are not there yet.
